meta.title: CAPEX Epic Progress
meta.subtitle: Plain-language roadmap for the repo-native CAPEX planning backlog.
meta.sourceNote: Generated from docs/planning/epics and codex/tasks with curated review-posture overrides.
meta.codexRule: When a CAPEX task is completed, set status: DONE, add completed_at in ISO 8601 timezone form, add completion/closeout evidence, and regenerate this progress data in the same change.

EPIC-139.reviewPosture: State C / repaired after final EPIC-139 redo acceptance: approval and workpage defaults are platform-neutral, logistics behavior activates explicitly, supported-environment evidence is recorded in TASK-0645, task-by-task reclose evidence is recorded in TASK-0646, and closure handoff evidence is recorded in TASK-0647.

EPIC-140.reviewPosture: Project-scoped APIs now include the first project child-route, selector/dashboard, shared project-scope helper, and official pointer-family slices; authorization projections, pointer-promotion policy checks, raw-corpus governance dependencies, and CAPEX activation are still gating work.

EPIC-144.reviewPosture: CAPEX review screens remain blocked until project-scoped foundations and risk/CEO workflow dependencies are ready.

EPIC-152.reviewPosture: Production preflight cannot pass until P0 blockers, three-project evidence, raw-data quarantine, restore, release, and review gates are proven.

TASK-0244.statusReason: The deploy lane exists, but live lab VM execute-and-smoke evidence is still missing.

TASK-0273.statusReason: Needs fresh check because the first project-scoped API foundation is closed and this task can now be reassessed against batch artifact provenance scope.

TASK-0280.statusReason: Needs fresh check because project-scoped official pointer families are now present, while promotion request and policy checks remain later scope.

TASK-0291.statusReason: Needs fresh check because the selector/dashboard slice is closed, while richer CAPEX workpages and route-tree shell scope remain later EPIC-144 work.

TASK-0299.statusReason: Needs fresh check because the risk/CEO view must not look product-ready before the risk workflow closes.

activationBlockers.plain: Repeated button presses can accidentally do the same work twice.
activationBlockers.action: Check whether the action was already recorded before doing the work again.

activationBlockers.plain: A document history link can point to the wrong project.
activationBlockers.action: Confirm the document and project belong together before saving the link.

activationBlockers.plain: An official-selection history entry can point to a document from another project.
activationBlockers.action: Confirm the selected document and the project match before recording the selection.

activationBlockers.plain: The risk/CEO view can look finished before the risk workflow is ready.
activationBlockers.action: Show it as blocked until the risk workflow closes.
